description: real/nist-ftc-09 spoiled by hand, the runner's refusal path under test (ADR-0026): face #2920's PLANE #2621 wrapped in #5849 = OFFSET_SURFACE('',#2621,0.,.F.), the one line added and the one reference changed. refused.why: face #2920 lies on OFFSET_SURFACE #5849: Arris has no offset surface, and a fitted one would not be the part (ADR-0025 §2)
